about.heading: A legacy of triumph driving Egypt's industrial and economic resurgence
about.desc1: MRG Group was established to be one of Egypt's most diversified economic leaders. Through strategic manufacturing facilities in the Ataqa Industrial Zone in Suez, Badr City, and Greater Cairo, the group pioneers local industrialization and circular recycling at top global benchmarks.
about.desc2: The group comprises elite leaders in polyester staple fiber, PET sheet & thermoformed packaging, security systems & light current, advertising raw materials, interactive digital signage, cultural publishing, medical congresses, and athletic & vocational empowerment.
about.visionDesc: To be the foremost industrial and investment partner across Egypt and the MENA region, championing circular economy practices and smart technological solutions.
about.missionDesc: Delivering exceptional quality products aligned with highest sustainability standards, generating meaningful employment, and strengthening the national economy.
